subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Do maintainers accept the upstream action-contract changes, particularly the `openai/codex-action` 1.8-to-1.11 update, in workflows that receive repository secrets and privileged tokens?
rationale: This is a trust-boundary decision about third-party workflow code and secret-bearing execution; repository-side edits cannot establish upstream behavioral compatibility without owner approval and contract inspection.

options.title: Review and validate the action revisions
options.body: Inspect the exact upstream action changes and run or observe scoped credentialed workflow validation before merging this grouped update.

options.title: Split or defer sensitive action updates
options.body: Land only independently validated low-risk action bumps and defer Codex or token-minting action revisions for separate owner review.

recommendation.title: Review and validate the action revisions
recommendation.body: Inspect the exact upstream action changes and run or observe scoped credentialed workflow validation before merging this grouped update.
